title: skills.sh.json
description: Hand-authored schema for skills.sh customization files. Matches the docs at https://www.skills.sh/docs/customize. The upstream URL listed in the $id field returns 404 today (2026-05-29); this local copy keeps validation working in CI until skills.sh publishes their own. When they do, scripts/update-schemas.mjs can fetch and replace this file.

$schema.description: Optional schema URL for editor autocomplete.

notGrouped.description: Placement of skills that are not listed in any grouping. Defaults to 'bottom'.

title.description: Section title shown on the skills.sh repo page.

description.description: Optional one-line description for the section.
